verses.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्र उवाच।
              तेष्वेवं सन्निवृत्तेषु प्रत्युद्यातेषु भागशः।  कथं युयुधिरे पार्था मामकाश्च तरस्विनः॥१॥
किमर्जुनश्चाप्यकरोत् संशप्तकबलं प्रति।  संशप्तका वा पार्थस्य किमकुर्वत सञ्जय॥२॥
verses.english: What also did Arjuna do to the car-warriors of the Samshaptaka host and what, O Sanjaya, did the Samshaptakas do to Arjuna in return?

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तथा तेषु निवृत्तेषु प्रत्युद्यातेषु भागशः।  स्वयमभ्यद्रवद्भीमं नागानीकेन ते सुतः॥३॥
स नाग इव नागेन गोवृषेणेव गोवृषः।  समाहूतः स्वयं राज्ञा नागानीकमुपाद्रवत्॥४॥
verses.english: Like an elephant challenged by another or like a bovine bull summoned by a rival, Bhimasena, challenged by the king himself, rushed against that elephant division.

verses.sanskrit: स युद्धकुशलः पार्थो बाहुर्वार्येण चान्वितः।  अभिनत् कुञ्जरानीकमचिरेणैव मारिष॥५॥
verses.english: And, O sire, that of Pritha, accomplished in battle and endued with strength of arms, soon shattered that host of elephants.

verses.sanskrit: ते गजा गिरिसंकाशाः क्षरन्तः सर्वतो मदम्।  भीमसेनस्य नाराचैर्विमुखा विमदीकृताः॥६॥
verses.english: Those elephants, prodigious like mountains and with ichor exuding from all parts of their bodies, were crushed and compelled to turn back by the Narachas of Bhimasena.

verses.sanskrit: विधमेदभ्रजालानि यथा वायुः समुद्धतः।  व्यधमत्तान्यनीकानि तथैव पवनात्मजः॥७॥
verses.english: Indeed as a raging tempest tears away a network of clouds, so did the son of the Wind (Bhima) shatter that host (of elephants).

verses.sanskrit: स तेषु विसृजन्बाणान् भीमो नागेष्वशोभत।  भुवनेष्विव सर्वेषु गभस्तीनुदितो रविः॥८॥
verses.english: Scattering arrows on that herd of elephants, Bhima appeared beautiful, like the sun scattering his shining rays on all objects of the world.

verses.sanskrit: ते भीमबाणाभिहताः संस्यूता विबभुर्गजाः।  गभस्तिभिरिवार्कस्य व्योम्नि नानाबलाहकाः॥९॥
verses.english: Afflicted with the shafts of Bhima and bespattered with biood, those elephants looked beautiful like various masses of clouds in the heavens streaked with the rays of the sun.

verses.sanskrit: तथा गजानां कदनं कुर्वाणमनिलात्मजम्।  क्रुद्धो दुर्योधनोभ्येत्य प्रत्यविध्यच्छितैः शरैः॥१०॥
verses.english: Thereupon Duryodhana excited with wrath, approached and pierced with whetted shafts the son of the Wind who was afflicting his (Duryodhana's) own division of elephants.

verses.sanskrit: ततः क्षणेन क्षितिपं क्षतजप्रतिमेक्षणः।  क्षयं निनीषुर्निशितैर्भीमो विव्याध पत्रिभिः॥११॥
verses.english: Thereat, with blood-red eyes, Bhima within a while, desirous of dragging the king to destruction, began to pierce the latter with winged shafts.

verses.sanskrit: स शराचितसर्वाङ्गः क्रुद्धो विव्याध पाण्डवम्।  नाराचैरर्करश्म्याभैर्भीमसेनं स्मयन्निवः॥१२॥
verses.english: Then Duryodhana, covered with arrows on all parts of his body and wrought up with rage, began to pierce the son of Pandu, viz., Bhimasena, with Narachas of the effulgence of the rays of the sun, laughing all the while.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य नागं मणिमयं रत्नचित्रध्वजे स्थितम्।  मल्लाभ्यां कार्मुकं चैव क्षिप्रं चिच्छेद पाण्डवः॥१३॥
verses.english: Duryodhana had an (artificial) elephant embossed with gems and jewels as the device gracing his banner; this elephant together with the former's blow, the son of Pandu severed with two Bhallas in all haste.

verses.sanskrit: दुर्योधनं पीड्यमानं दृष्ट्वा भीमेन मारिष।  चुक्षोभयिषुरभ्यागादङ्गो मातङ्गमास्थितः॥१४॥
तमापतन्तं नागेन्द्रमम्बुदप्रतिमस्वनम्।  कुंभान्तरे भामसेनो नाराचैरार्दयद्भृशम्॥१५॥
verses.english: Secing that best of elephants make towards himself with a roar resembling the rumble of the clouds, Bhima struck it sore with a Naracha between its two frontal globes.

verses.sanskrit: तस्य कायं विनिर्भिद्य न्यमज्जद्धरणीतले।  ततः पपात द्विरदो वज्राहत इवाचलः॥१६॥
तस्यावर्जितनागस्य म्लेच्छस्याधः पतिष्यतः।  शिरश्चिच्छेद भल्लेन क्षिप्रकारी वृकोदरः॥१७॥
verses.english: The Mlechha king who could not extricate himself from the dropping elephant was also falling with it; with an admirable lightness of hand, Vrikodara cut-off the head of that monarch.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मिन्निपतिते वीरे संप्राद्रवत साचमूः।  संभ्रान्ताश्वद्विपरथा पदातीनवमृद्नती॥१८॥
तेष्वनीकेषु भग्नेषु विद्रवत्सु समंततः।  प्राग्ज्योतिषस्ततो भीमं कुञ्जरेण समाद्रवत्॥१९॥
verses.english: When that host had been thus broken and rouled in all directions, the sovereign of the Pragjyotisas rushed at Bhima, riding on his elephant.

verses.sanskrit: येन नागेन मघवानजयद्दैत्यदानवान्।  तदन्वयेन नागेन भीमसेनमुपाद्रवत्॥२०॥
verses.english: Bhagadatta attacked on Bhimasena by riding on the elephant of Airavata breed using which as vehicle, Indra had defeated the demons and monsters.

verses.sanskrit: स नागप्रवरो भीमं सहसा समुपाद्रवत्।  चरणाभ्यामथो द्वाभ्यां संहतेन करेण च॥२१॥
verses.english: With its two forelegs and its trunk contracted and with its eyes rolling and inflamed with fury, the elephant seemed to consume the son of Pandu. It then shattered to pieces the car of Vrikodara together with the steeds harnessed thereto. Thereat running on his legs Bhima hid himself underneath body of the elephant.

verses.sanskrit: व्यावृत्तनयनः कुद्धः प्रमथन्निव पाण्डवम्।  वृकोदररथं साश्वमविशेषमचूर्णयत्॥२२॥
पद्भ्यां भीमोऽप्यथो धावंस्तस्य गात्रेष्वलीयत।  जानन्नञ्जलिकावेधं नापाक्रामत पाण्डवः॥२३॥
verses.english: The son of Pandu did not really fly, for he was acquainted with the science called Anjalikavedha. Getting underneath the elephant's body, that elephant that was intent on slaying him; he began to strike it with his bare arms repeatedly.

verses.sanskrit: गात्राभ्यन्तरगो भूत्वा करेणाताडयन्मुहुः।  लालयामास तं नागं वधाकाङ्क्षिणमव्ययम्॥२४॥
कुलालचक्रवन्नागस्तदा तूर्णमथाभ्रमत्।  नागायुतबलः श्रीमान् कालयानो वृकोदरम्॥२५॥
verses.english: He began to afflict that elephant that was intent on slaying him; Whereupon the elephant began to whirl round like a potter's wheel in rapid motion. Possessed of the might of ten thousand elephants, the glorious Vrikodara, having struck the elephant. Came out from underneath its body and stood stood before Supratika.

verses.sanskrit: भीमोऽपि निष्क्रम्य ततः सुप्रतीकाग्रतोऽभवत्। भीमं करेणावनम्य जानुभ्यामभ्यताडयत्॥२६॥
ग्रीवायां वेष्टयित्वैनं स गजो हन्तुमैहत।  करवेष्टं भीमसेनो भ्रमं दत्त्वा व्यमोचयत्॥२७॥
verses.english: Holding down Bhima with its trunk, Supratika then struck him with its knees. And winding its trunk round the neck of Bhima, it really tried to kill him. Whirling round Bhimasena freed himself from the twine of the elephant's trunk.

verses.sanskrit: पुनर्गात्राणि नागस्यः प्रविवेश वृकोदरः।  यावत्प्रतिगजायातं स्वबले प्रत्यवैक्षत॥२८॥
verses.english: Then once more Vrikodara got under the body of that elephant. Then when he saw a rival elephant of his own army make towards the one (underneath which he was standing).

verses.sanskrit: भीमोऽपि नागगात्रेभ्यो विनिःसृत्यापयाज्जवात्। ततः सर्वस्य सैन्यस्य नादः समभवन्महान्॥२९॥
verses.english: Bhima issuing out from under the body of the elephant, ran away with speed. Thereupon cry in whole army.

verses.sanskrit: अहो धिडिहतो भीमः कुञ्जरेणेति मारिष।  तेन नागेन सन्त्रस्ता पाण्डवानामनीकिनी॥३०॥
verses.english: 'Alas, Bhima is slain by the elephant' was set up by all the troops, O sire. Frightened by that elephant, the Pandava army suddenly fled, O king, there where Vrikodara was standing.

verses.sanskrit: सहसाऽभ्यद्रवद्राजन् यत्र तस्थौ वृकोदरः।  ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा हतं मत्वा वृकोदरम्॥३१॥
verses.english: Thereupon, considering Vrikodara to be slain, king Yudhishthira assisted by the Panchalas, environed Bhagadatta on all sides. a loud

verses.sanskrit: भगदत्तं सपाञ्चाल्यः सर्वतः समवारयत्।  तं रथं रथिनां श्रेष्ठाः परिवार्य परंतपाः॥३२॥
verses.english: That foremost of car-warriors Yudhishthira, having surrounded Bhagadatta with cars on all sides, covered the latter with keen-pointed shafts by hundreds and thousands.

verses.sanskrit: अवाकिरन् शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।  सविघातं पृषत्कानामङ्कुशेन समाहरन्॥३३॥
गजेन पाण्डुपञ्चालान् व्यधमत् पर्वतेश्वरः।  तद‌द्भुतमपश्याम भगद‌त्तस्य संयुगे॥३४॥
verses.english: Baffling those myriad shafts with his iron hook, the Mountain-king, (Bhagadatta) agitated with his elephant the host of the Pandavas and the Panchalas.

verses.sanskrit: तथा वृद्धस्य चरितं कुञ्जरेण विशांपते।  ततो राजा दशार्णानां प्राग्ज्योतिषमुपाद्रवत्॥३५॥
verses.english: Then, O ruler of men, we did indeed behold a wonderful feat achieved in that battle by the old Bhagadatta, through the instrumentality of his elephant.

verses.sanskrit: तिर्यग्यातेन नागेन समदेनाशुगामिना।  तयोर्युद्धं समभवन्नागयोर्भीमरूपयोः॥३६॥
verses.english: Then the sovereign of the Dasarnas advanced against the ruler of the Pragjyotisas, mounted on a swift-coursing elephant exuding the temporal juice and moving in a tortuous inotion.

verses.sanskrit: सपक्षयोः पर्वतयोर्यथा सद्रुमयोः पुरा।  प्राग्ज्योतिषपतेर्नागः सन्निवृत्यापसृत्य च॥३७॥
verses.english: Then the encounter that ensued between those two elephants of prodigious appearance, resembled the fight, in the days of yore, between winged mountains covered with trees.

verses.sanskrit: पार्श्वे दशार्णाधिपतेर्भित्त्वा नागमपातयत्।  तोमरैः सूर्यरश्म्याभैर्भगदत्तोऽथ सप्तभिः॥३८॥
verses.english: Thereafter the elephant of the ruler of the Pragjyotisas, turning and wheeling round, slew the elephant of the king of the Dasarnas, by ripping open its flanks.

verses.sanskrit: जघान द्विरदस्थं तं शत्रुं प्रचलितासनम्।  व्यवच्छिद्य तु राजानं भगदत्तं युधिष्ठिरः॥३९॥
verses.english: King Bhagadatta also, with seven Tomaras of the effulgence of the sur's rays, slew his adversary riding on an elephant just when the latter was about to slip down from his seat.

verses.sanskrit: रथानीकेन महता सर्वतः पर्यवारयत्।  स कुञ्जरस्थो रथिभिः शुशुभे सर्वतो वृतः॥४०॥
verses.english: Thereupon Yudhishthira lacerating king Bhagadatta (with many shafts), surrounding him on all sides with a numerous host of carwarriors.

verses.sanskrit: पर्वतं वनमध्यस्थो ज्वलन्निव हुताशनः।  मण्डलं सर्वतः श्लिष्टं रथिनामुग्रधन्विनाम्॥४१॥
verses.english: Mounted on his elephant and surrounded on all sides by the car-warriors, he (Bhagadatta) appeared beautiful like fire illumining a mountain surrounded by forests.

verses.sanskrit: किरतां शरवर्षाणि स नागः पर्यवर्तत। ततः प्राग्ज्योतिषो राजा परिगृह्य महागजम्॥४२॥
verses.english: Then mounted on his elephant, he remained inside that compact circle of fierce bow-men riding on chariots and pouring showers of arrows. a

verses.sanskrit: प्रेषयामास सहसा युयुधानरथं प्रति।  शिनेः पौत्रस्य तु रथं परिगृह्य महाद्विपः॥४३॥
verses.english: Thereat the mighty elephant twining with its trunks the car of Sini's grandson, threw it violently to distance; but Yuyudhana escaped.

verses.sanskrit: अभिचिक्षेप वेगेन युयुधानस्त्वपाक्रमत्।  बृहतः सैन्धवानश्वान् समुत्थाप्याथ सारथिः॥४४॥
तस्थौ सात्यकिमासाद्य संप्लतस्तं रथं प्रति।  स तु लब्ध्वान्तरं नागस्त्वरितो रथमण्डलात्॥४५॥
verses.english: His charioteer jumping upon the car, urged the mighty steeds of the Shindhu breed yoked thereto and stopped reaching the spot where Satyaki was sianding.

verses.sanskrit: निश्चक्राम ततः सर्वान् परिचिक्षेप पार्थिवान्।  ते त्वाशुगतिना तेन त्रास्यमाना नरर्षभाः॥४६॥
verses.english: Then that elephani, availing itself of that breach in the circle of cars, came speedily out of it and began to overthrow all the rulers of the carth.

verses.sanskrit: तमेकं द्विरदं संख्ये मेनिरे शतशो द्विपान्।  ते गजस्थेन काल्यन्ते भगदत्तेन पाण्डवाः॥४७॥
verses.english: Those foremost of men being frightened by that swift-coursing elephant, regarded that single one to be multiplied into hundred elephants, in that battle.

verses.sanskrit: ऐरावतस्थेन यथा देवराजेन दानवाः। तेषां प्रद्रवतां भीमः पञ्चालानामितस्ततः॥४८॥
verses.english: The Pandavas crushed by Bhagadatta mounted on his elephant, appeared like the Danavas crushed by Indra mounted on his clephant, appeared like the Danavas crushed by Indra mounted on the Airavata.

verses.sanskrit: गजवाजिकृतः शब्दः सुमहान् समजायत।  भगदत्तेन समरे काल्यमानेषु पाण्डुषु॥४९॥
verses.english: When the Panchalas were flying on all sides, a defending and dreadful din was created by their elephants and steeds.

verses.sanskrit: प्राग्ज्योतिषमभिक्रुद्धः पुनर्भीमः समभ्ययात्।  तस्याभिद्रवतो वाहान् हस्तमुक्तेन वारिणा॥५०॥
verses.english: Thus when the Pandavas were being afflicted by Bhagadatta in that battle, Bhima wrought up with wrath once more rushed against the ruler of the Pragjyotisas.

verses.sanskrit: समघ्नञ्छरवर्षेण रथस्थोऽन्तकसन्निभः।  ततः स रुचिपर्वाणं शरेणानतपर्वणा॥५०॥
verses.english: Thus when the Pandavas were being afflicted by Bhagadatta in that battle, Bhima wrought up with wrath once more rushed against the ruler of the Pragjyotisas.

verses.sanskrit: सिक्त्वा व्यत्रासयन्नागस्ते पार्थमहरंस्ततः।  ततस्तमभ्ययात् तूर्णं रुचिपर्वा कृती सुतः॥५१॥
verses.english: Then that elephant drenching with the water spouting from its trunk the horses of the advancing Bhima, frightened them and they carried away Bhima from the field.

verses.sanskrit: सुपर्वा पर्वतपतिर्निन्ये वैवस्वतक्षयम्।  तस्मिन्निपतिते वीरे सौभद्रो द्रौपदीसुतः॥५१॥
verses.english: Then that elephant drenching with the water spouting from its trunk the horses of the advancing Bhima, frightened them and they carried away Bhima from the field.

verses.sanskrit: चेकितानो धृष्टकेतुर्युयुत्सुश्चार्दयन् द्विपम्। त एनं शरधाराभिर्धाराभिरिव तोयदाः॥५२॥
verses.english: On the fall of that hero (Ruchiparvan), the son of Subhadra, the sons of Draupadi, Chekitana, Dhristaketu and Yuyutsu, began to afflict that elephant. Desirous of slaying it; and uttering dreadful roars, they began to pour on it their arrows like showers of rain.

verses.sanskrit: सिषिचुर्भैरवान्नादान् विनदन्तो जिघांसवः।  ततः पार्ष्ण्यंकुशाङ्गुष्ठैः कृतिना चोदितो द्विपः॥५५॥
प्रसारितकरः प्रायात् स्तब्धकर्णेक्षणो द्रुतम्।  सोऽधिष्ठाय पदा वाहान् युयुत्सोः सूतमारुजत्॥५६॥
verses.english: Then that elephant urged with heels toes and the hook, by its skillful rider, rushed (at them) with speed, with its trunk stretched and eyes and ear fixed trampling upon the steeds of Yuyutsu, the animal crushed his charioteer.

verses.sanskrit: युयुत्सुस्तु रथाद्राजन्नपात्रामत् त्वरान्वितः।  ततः पाण्डवयोधास्ते नागराजं शरैर्दुतम्॥५७॥
verses.english: O monarch, Yuyutsu fled, forsaking his car, in ail haste. Then the warriors of the Pandava host out of a desire for slaying that foremost of elephants, speedily drenched it with the shower of their arrows, uttering loud shouts all the while.

verses.sanskrit: सिषिचुर्भैरवान्नादान् विनदन्तो जिघांसवः।  पुत्रस्तु तव संभ्रान्तः सौभद्रस्याप्लुतो रथम्॥५८॥
verses.english: At this juncture, your son with speed rushed, against the car or Subhadra's son. King Bhagadatta riding on his elephant and discharging arrows at the foc appeared resplendent like the sun scattering his rays on the earth.

verses.sanskrit: स कुञ्जरस्थो विसृजन्निषूनरिषु पार्थिवः।  बभौ रश्मीनिवादित्यो भुवनेषु समुत्सृजन्॥५९॥
तमार्जुनिर्द्वादशभिर्युयुत्सुर्दशभिः शरैः।  त्रिभिस्त्रिभिर्दौपदेया धृष्टकेतुश्च विव्यधुः॥६०॥
सोऽतियत्नार्पितैर्बाणैराचितो द्विरदो बभौ। संस्यूत इव सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्जलदो महान्॥६१॥
नियन्तुःशिल्पयत्नाभ्यां प्रेरितोऽरिशरार्दितः।  परिचिक्षेप तान्नागः स रिपून् सव्यदक्षिणम्॥६२॥
verses.english: Urged on by the skill and vigour of its rider and smitten with the shafts of the enemy. That clephant began to throw down right and left, the warriors of the hostile host.

verses.sanskrit: गोपाल इव दण्डेन यथा पशुगणान् वने।  आवेष्टयत तां सेनां भगदत्तस्तथा मुहुः॥६३॥
क्षिप्रं श्येनाभिपन्नानां वायसानामिव स्वनः।  बभूव पाण्डवेयानां भृशं विद्रवतां स्वनः॥६४॥
verses.english: Like the cawing of the crows pounced upon by the hawks. A confused noise was heard among the Pandava hosts, as they fled with speed.

verses.sanskrit: स नागराजः प्रवराङ्कुशाहतः पुरा सपक्षोऽद्रिवरो यथा नृप।  भयं तदा रिपुषु समादधद्भृशं वणिग्जनानां क्षुभितो यथार्णवः॥६५॥
verses.english: O monarch, then that foremost of elephants being struck with the hook resembled with winged mountains of yore. It struck panic into the hearts of the enemy, like to what the merchants (on board) experience when the (tempest-tossed) sea rushes against them.

verses.sanskrit: ततो ध्वनिर्द्विरदरथाश्वपार्थिवैर्भयाद्द्रवद्भिर्जनितोऽतिभैरवः।  क्षितिं वियद् द्यां विदिशो दिशस्तथा समावृणोत् पार्थिव संयुगे ततः॥६६॥
स तेन नागप्रवरेण पार्थिवो भृशं जगाहे द्विषतामनीकिनीम्।  पुरा सुगुप्तां विबुधैरिवाहवे विरोचनो देववरूथिनीमिव॥६७॥
भृशं ववौ ज्वलनसखोवियद्रजः समावृणोन्मुहुरपि चैव सैनिकान्।  तमेकनागं गणशो यथा गजान् समन्ततो द्रुतमथ मेनिरे जनाः॥६८॥
